decision_conditions:
The
development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the
approved plans and documents:Design & Access Statement dated
October 2024, Drw No: PA-105-202, Drw No: PA-105-201, Drw No: PA-105-200, Drw
No: PA-105-102, PA-105-101, PA-105-100, PA-105-000, PA-105-001. 







REASON: For
the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The restaurant use hereby permitted
shall not be open to customers outside the following times:- 9:30am hours to 22:30pm
hours, Monday to Saturday inclusive, and 10:30am hours to 22:00 hours on
Sundays, without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.&nbsp;

The motorbike use hereby permitted
shall not be open to customers outside the following times:- 9am hours to 20:00pm
hours, Monday to Saturday inclusive, and 10:30am hours to 18:00 hours on
Sundays, without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.

Within 3 months of the date on the
decision notice, details of the refuse, waste and recycling facilities within
the site boundary shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local
planning authority.&nbsp; &nbsp;The approved details shall be implemented and retained thereafter.&nbsp;
<p>The sui generis use hereby permitted shall only be used for the purposes specified in the application.</p><p>Reason: To safeguard the amenity of the neighbouring residents.</p>
description: Change of use from Class E to Multi-Use Class E (Barber Shop, Restaurant) and Motorbike Shop (Class Sui Generis)  (retrospective) (Amended description only)
subdivision_of_building: Rear Side, one commercial unit divided into two units. Previously restaurant selling pizza, converted into a motorbike shop and restaurant.
